mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a comfortable 76 degrees out by the Verona Area High School, with a beautiful waxing gibbous moon expected to be visible tonight.

The City of Verona has two major updates: the Department of Public Works is seeking an Engineering Technician for municipal projects by September 20, and the Common Council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure our systems remain self-supporting and fully maintained.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at various venues happening today, followed by a free girls try hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena tomorrow.

In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on August 15 where a driver was arrested for a first offence O W I after officers found the vehicle stopped near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake, and you can pick it up at Culver's until they close at 10:30 PM. Also, for those looking for a frozen treat at the game, the Kona Ice truck will be at the Verona Area High School football kickoff at 6 PM today.
